LanguageData.LP_AbyssCore.label: abyssal body
LanguageData.LP_AbyssCore.description: The body of an abyssal demon: turns into black smoke and is banished to the Abyss when knocked down or killed (except bound ones or those in a planar anchor chain); not bothered by being naked. Cold iron weapons deal ×1.5 damage to it.
LanguageData.LP_AbyssCore.customEffectDescriptions.0: Downed or killed: banished to the Abyss; enemies drop soul coins, demon blood and more.
LanguageData.LP_AbyssCore.customEffectDescriptions.1: Cold iron weapons deal ×1.5 damage, holy radiance from faith ×1.25.
LanguageData.LP_AbyssCore.customEffectDescriptions.2: Immune to psychic effects other than abyssal taint... and cannot be tainted.
LanguageData.LP_AbyssUndying.label: sleepless and foodless
LanguageData.LP_AbyssUndying.description: Creatures of the Abyss need neither food nor sleep.
LanguageData.LP_DretchStature.label: manes build
LanguageData.LP_DretchStature.description: A short, fat body: actual body size ×70%, drawn ×80%, a pair of small horns on top.
LanguageData.LP_DretchStench.label: manes stench
LanguageData.LP_DretchStench.description: Manes reek of rot: other humanlikes within 2 cells get mood -2.
LanguageData.LP_DretchToil.label: drudge
LanguageData.LP_DretchToil.description: Manes only understand the simplest orders: they can only haul, mine, clean and do menial work; global work speed ×0.8.
LanguageData.LP_SkinDretch.label: ashen skin
LanguageData.LP_SkinDretch.description: The dead-fish ashen skin of manes.
LanguageData.LP_BarlguraStature.label: barlgura build
LanguageData.LP_BarlguraStature.description: A hulking ape-like body: actual body size ×160%, drawn ×130%, ape face and jutting tusks. Giant-body rules make its health and melee stronger.
LanguageData.LP_BarlguraMight.label: ape strength
LanguageData.LP_BarlguraMight.description: The barlgura's brute strength: +20% melee damage, +40% carry capacity.
LanguageData.LP_BarlguraLeap.label: leap strike
LanguageData.LP_BarlguraLeap.description: Ability "Leap strike": leap next to a target within 8 cells; on landing, enemies within 1 cell make a Dexterity save (difficulty 13, base success 50%) or fall for 1 second. Cooldown 6 hours.
LanguageData.LP_BarlguraStill.label: still invisibility
LanguageData.LP_BarlguraStill.description: After standing still without attacking for 3 seconds it melts into the shadows and cannot be seen; moving or attacking reveals it.
LanguageData.LP_BarlguraBrute.label: bloodthirsty
LanguageData.LP_BarlguraBrute.description: Barlguras cannot learn to read, paint, tend wounds or sweet-talk; +5 mood when watching an execution.
LanguageData.LP_SkinBarlgura.label: orange-brown skin
LanguageData.LP_SkinBarlgura.description: The coarse orange-brown hide of a barlgura.
LanguageData.LP_HezrouStature.label: hezrou build
LanguageData.LP_HezrouStature.description: A huge toad-like body: actual body size ×180%, drawn ×140%, a wide-mouthed toad head.
LanguageData.LP_HezrouHide.label: warty hide
LanguageData.LP_HezrouHide.description: Thick, tough, warty hide: sharp and blunt armor +20% each; no slowdown in shallow water or marsh.
LanguageData.LP_HezrouStench.label: hezrou stench
LanguageData.LP_HezrouStench.description: Every 5 seconds, hostile humanlikes within 3 cells make a Constitution save (difficulty 13, base success 50%) or are "nauseated" for 10 seconds (manipulation -20%, move speed ×0.9). Those who succeed are unaffected for 1 minute.
LanguageData.LP_SkinHezrou.label: green-grey warty hide
LanguageData.LP_SkinHezrou.description: The green-grey, warty hide of a hezrou.
LanguageData.LP_SuccubusNature.label: succubus nature
LanguageData.LP_SuccubusNature.description: Succubus / incubus nature: social impact +25%, negotiated prices +10%; fire and burn damage ×0.5, toxic resistance +50%; eats only 20% as much as a normal person. Cannot work within 5 cells of an altar; mood -3 when seeing a holy symbol. Anyone with this gene counts as a succubus.
LanguageData.LP_SuccubusHorns.label: succubus horns
LanguageData.LP_SuccubusHorns.description: A pair of small curved horns. Hidden during shapeshift disguise.
LanguageData.LP_SuccubusWings.label: succubus wings
LanguageData.LP_SuccubusWings.description: A pair of purple-black bat wings. Hidden during shapeshift disguise.
LanguageData.LP_SuccubusTail.label: succubus tail
LanguageData.LP_SuccubusTail.description: A thin tail ending in a heart-shaped tip. Hidden during shapeshift disguise.
LanguageData.LP_SuccubusGuise.label: shapeshift disguise
LanguageData.LP_SuccubusGuise.description: A toggleable illusion: while on, horns, wings, tail and crimson skin are hidden and it looks like an ordinary person. Being seen by a devil's eye (8 cells) or an aasimar (5 cells) dispels it automatically.
LanguageData.LP_SuccubusKiss.label: charming kiss
LanguageData.LP_SuccubusKiss.description: Ability "Charming kiss" (touch, cooldown 1 day): the target makes a Wisdom save (difficulty rises with the succubus's proficiency bonus and Charisma; each point of the target's ability modifier and proficiency bonus gives +5% success). On failure: enemies are charmed for 60 seconds; prisoners lose 15 recruit resistance; colonists gain +20 opinion of it. Those who succeed are immune for 24 hours.
LanguageData.LP_SuccubusDream.label: dream drain
LanguageData.LP_SuccubusDream.description: Settled every day at 6 AM: whoever slept in its bed the previous night gets rest -20%, abyssal taint +3% and nightmares; it heals some wounds and gains the "sated" mood +6 for two days. After 3 days without draining, "thirsting" mood -4.
LanguageData.LP_SkinSuccubus.label: crimson skin
LanguageData.LP_SkinSuccubus.description: A succubus's skin is tinged crimson. (60% of succubi have normal skin.)
LanguageData.LP_CambionBlood.label: abyssal lineage
LanguageData.LP_CambionBlood.description: Demon blood runs in the veins: cold iron deals ×1.25 damage, abyssal taint ×0.5; with VPE installed it counts as a sorcerer bloodline (path requirement -2). Anyone with this gene counts as a cambion.
LanguageData.LP_CambionHorns.label: cambion horns
LanguageData.LP_CambionHorns.description: A pair of backward-curving horns and golden-red eyes.
LanguageData.LP_CambionWings.label: demon wings
LanguageData.LP_CambionWings.description: A pair of small bat wings; cannot fly, but can glide. Ability "Gliding leap": jump to a spot within 6 cells, cooldown 4 hours.
LanguageData.LP_CambionFire.label: abyssal fire
LanguageData.LP_CambionFire.description: Fire knows demon blood: fire and burn damage ×0.5.
LanguageData.LP_CambionPresence.label: abyssal presence
LanguageData.LP_CambionPresence.description: Born knowing how to make people afraid or obedient: social talent +2.
LanguageData.LP_NabassuStature.label: nabassu build
LanguageData.LP_NabassuStature.description: A gargoyle-like body: actual body size ×160%, drawn ×130%, bat wings on the back and long fangs.
LanguageData.LP_NabassuDevour.label: soul devour
LanguageData.LP_NabassuDevour.description: The souls of humanlikes it kills are devoured: they cannot be resurrected by any means (resurrector serum, divine magic and a lich's phylactery all fail), and after 24 hours there is a 30% chance they rise as hostile manes. Each soul it devours grants 1 "soul-gorged" stack (+5% health, +5% damage, up to 10 stacks).
LanguageData.LP_NabassuDevour.customEffectDescription: Kills a humanlike: the soul is devoured, gaining 1 soul-gorged stack.
LanguageData.LP_NabassuGaze.label: petrifying gaze
LanguageData.LP_NabassuGaze.description: Ability "Petrifying gaze" (6 cells, cooldown 30 seconds): one person makes a Constitution save (difficulty 14, base success 45%) or has move speed ×0.5 for 10 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_SkinNabassu.label: grey-black stone skin
LanguageData.LP_SkinNabassu.description: The grey-black hide of a nabassu, like weathered rock.
LanguageData.LP_ShadowDemonForm.label: formless shadow
LanguageData.LP_ShadowDemonForm.description: Shadow demons are almost incorporeal: weapons (including claws and fangs) that are non-magic, below masterwork quality and not cold iron or silver deal only half damage. It fears light: standing on a cell with 50%+ light it takes ×1.5 damage and moves ×0.7.
LanguageData.LP_SkinShadowDemon.label: pitch-black shadow
LanguageData.LP_SkinShadowDemon.description: A shadow demon's body is like congealed black smoke.
